How it works

Five steps from feed to payout

Screens below are from the partner dashboard you get on day one. The listings shown are examples; the live feed changes every week.

STEP 1 OF 5

Pick an app from this week's feed

Every Monday the feed shows what the studio launched or refreshed. Each listing tells you the price, your bounty, the category and whether the creative kit is ready. Nothing appears until its bounties are funded.

Only apps with paying customers and a working checkout make the feed. We test the funnel before you spend a minute on it.

firstmonth.app/offers
STEP 2 OF 5

Grab your link, your coupon and the kit

One click gives you a tracked link and a personal coupon code that gives your audience 10% off month one. The kit has a demo video, screenshots in light and dark, a written angle with three hooks, a free creator account and the disclosure text.

Use both the link and the coupon. If a browser blocks the cookie, the coupon still credits you.

firstmonth.app/offers/draftline
STEP 3 OF 5

Post the way you always do

A review, a tutorial, a "five tools this week" segment, a newsletter mention, a Discord pin. Your format, your voice. We ask for two things: an honest take and a visible disclosure, which the kit gives you word for word.

No brand bidding, no coupon sites, no incentivised sign-ups. That protects your bounty as much as ours.

firstmonth.app/links
STEP 4 OF 5

Watch each referral move from click to renewal

Your earnings page shows every referral by stage: clicked, signed up, paid month one, renewed. A bounty becomes payable the day the subscriber's second payment clears, usually about 35 days after they sign up.

Refunds inside the hold window cancel that bounty and nothing else. You never owe money back.

firstmonth.app/earnings
STEP 5 OF 5

Get one payout for every app, on the 1st

Payable bounties across all apps go out together on the first of the month by Wise or Stripe, once they reach $50. Your tax form is collected once at sign-up. Monthly statements as PDF.

Every listing is pre-funded before it appears. If we retire an app inside 12 months, earned bounties are paid from that escrow.

The terms, in full

Same terms on every listing

No per-app negotiation and no surprises in the fine print. What a listing can change is the price of the app, and so the size of the bounty above the floor.

Bounty100% of the subscriber's first monthly payment
Floor$25.00, even on a $9 app
Payablewhen the 2nd renewal clears
Attribution60-day link, plus your coupon
Refund inside holdthat bounty is cancelled, no clawback
Payout1st of the month, $50 minimum, Wise or Stripe
App retired earlyearned bounties paid from escrow
Program notice60 days before any change to these terms

Questions

What partners ask first

Why 100% of month one and not a recurring share?

Because a full payment after your first referral is what makes creators keep going, and because for a new app the first paying month is the number that matters. If you would rather have a recurring split on a listing, tell us in the application. We are testing both in the pilot.

Why wait for the second renewal?

It covers the refund window without a clawback, it filters out sign-ups that were never real, and it means the studio only pays for subscribers who stayed. The hold is about 35 days, in line with the 30 to 90 day holds on most programs.

What happens if the studio kills an app?

Every listing is pre-funded before you see it. If an app is retired inside 12 months of listing, bounties you already earned are paid from that escrow on the normal schedule. You also get 60 days' notice before any change to the terms.

Can I subscribe through my own link?

No. Self-referrals are cancelled, and because bounties pay after the second renewal there is nothing to gain. Coupon sites, paid ads on the app's name and incentivised sign-ups are out for the same reason.

Do I need to be in the US?

No. We collect a W-9 or W-8BEN once at sign-up and pay by Wise or Stripe in your currency. EU partners invoice under reverse charge, which the monthly statement handles for you.

Who is the studio?

An independent product studio building small subscription apps with AI tooling. Every app in the feed has paying customers before it is listed, and the person who built it reads your feedback.
